name: Donating Money
overview: Scripture teaches that true trust and faith must be placed in the Lord rather than in human strength or wealth, as Jeremiah 17:5 warns against relying on man. Luke 16:11 challenges believers to be faithful with earthly resources, indicating that faithfulness in managing money is linked to receiving greater spiritual riches. James 2:14 emphasizes that faith without corresponding works, such as acts of generosity, is incomplete, underscoring the necessity of demonstrating genuine faith through tangible deeds like donating money.
